title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 14, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $396,022.17 to
text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 14, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $396,022.17 to
  provide vehicles to Motor Transport Division, as set forth.  [BPC #26-324]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and TRANSMIT to the Mayor.
summary: The police board will approve and forward to the Mayor a report on a donation valued at $396,022.17 that provides vehicles to the Motor Transport Division.

details.action: approve donation report and transmit to Mayor
